Field/Scenario: Toggling includeInNetWorth from true to false recalculates net worth to exclude amount
Preconditions: Gratuity record exists with expectedGratuityAmount=548076.92, includeInNetWorth=true, currently counted in net worth
Test Steps: 1. Note current net worth total. 2. Open record, uncheck includeInNetWorth. 3. Save. 4. Refresh net worth dashboard.
Test Data: includeInNetWorth changed from true to false
Expected Result: Net worth total decreases by 548076.92; value() function now returns BigDecimal.ZERO; allocation map becomes empty (no DEBT contribution)

Field/Scenario: Toggling includeInNetWorth from false to true recalculates net worth to include amount
Preconditions: Gratuity record exists with expectedGratuityAmount=185000.00, includeInNetWorth=false, currently excluded from net worth
Test Steps: 1. Note current net worth total. 2. Open record, check includeInNetWorth. 3. Save. 4. Refresh net worth dashboard.
Test Data: includeInNetWorth changed from false to true
Expected Result: Net worth total increases by 185000.00; value() function now returns 185000.00; allocation map now shows 100% DEBT contribution
